```{css, echo=FALSE}
.title{
  font-size: 30px;
  color: #4A4B4B;
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 0px;
}

.sched table tbody tr:has(.pract-row) td,
.sched table tbody tr:has(.lab-row) td{
  background-color: #FEF6F4 !important;
  color: #C2570F;
}

.sched table tbody tr:has(.quiz-row) td{
  background-color: #F2F8FC !important;
  color: #1A73B8;
}

.sched table tbody tr:has(.proj-row) td{
  background-color: #F5F6FC !important;
  color: #7A5590;
}

/* Links in due rows match the row color */
.sched table tbody tr:has(.pract-row) a,
.sched table tbody tr:has(.proj-row) a { color: inherit; }

/* ---- Blank separator rows: any row whose cells are all empty turns blue ---- */
.sched table tbody tr:not(:has(td:not(:empty))) td {
  background-color: #4CB1FF !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;   /* stops Bootstrap's striping from covering it */
  padding: 0 !important;
  height: 10px;
  line-height: 0;
  border: none;
}

.sched table th:nth-of-type(1) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(2) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(3) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(4) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(5) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(6) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(7) {
  width: 30% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(8) {
  width: 10% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(9) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(10) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(11) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
.sched table th:nth-of-type(12) {
  width: 5% !important;
}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("class_dates.R"))
```

**Reading key:** [VDS](https://vdsbook.com/) = *Veridical Data Science*; [Shell](https://swcarpentry.github.io/shell-novice/) = *The Unix Shell* (Software Carpentry); [DSatCL](https://jeroenjanssens.com/dsatcl/) = *Data Science at the Command Line*; [Happy Git](https://happygitwithr.com/) = *Happy Git and GitHub for the useR*; [renv](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/) = renv documentation; [Intro SQL](https://intro-sql-fh.netlify.app/) = *Intro to SQL* (Fred Hutch); [PDA](https://wesmckinney.com/book/) = *Python for Data Analysis*; [R4DS](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) = *R for Data Science*; [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/guide/) = Quarto guide.

Weeks 5 and 6 use EHR data only as practice material for SQL, not to teach EHR methods.
